pickup_locations: Local locker (custom beef and whole lamb)
Iowa Food Hub drop locations such as Cedar Falls, Cedar Rapids and Des Moines (custom orders, fee billed by Iowa Food Hub)

availability.note: Custom quarter and half beef sold out for 2026; the farm keeps a waitlist. Retail cuts sold at the farm store on Friday pizza nights.

notes: Run by Maren and Tom Beard near Decorah in northeast Iowa; the farm also runs pizza nights and a farm store. Read homepage, beef, lamb and farm store pages (WebFetch summaries only, so the Verifier should recheck the verbatim quote, which is a photo caption on the beef page). Beef page: cattle get grass and hay, mineral and salt throughout their lives. Lamb page says lambs are never fed grain and the farm grows all the hay its sheep eat. Retail beef and lamb cuts sold at the farm store on Friday pizza nights (4pm to 8pm); custom quarter or half beef and whole lamb picked up at the locker (not named) or delivered through Iowa Food Hub drop sites. The farm store also carries goods from over 50 local makers, but no meat from other farms was seen. Tom's parents run a separate dairy, not part of this farm. No phone published. Not in western or southern Iowa.
